meta.name: Dandivine
meta.description: Twenty years have passed since the combining robot Dandivine repelled the mysterious enemy known as the Aposdoll. The world was at peace, but the toy manufacturer Kasuga, which once took the world by storm through its Dandivine toy line, was in a steady decline due to an over-reliance on the franchise. Genjuro Shijima, the president of Kasga, now yearns for the resurrection of Dandivine, even if it means disturbing the peace of the world. As if his desire reached the heavens, an Aposdoll appears in Tokyo once again.

videos.title: An Old-Fashioned Guardian
videos.overview: 20 years after it's win over the Aposdoll invaders, the giant robot, Dandivine, seems like a fading memory...

videos.title: An Ace, but Only Because of His Face
videos.overview: As he worries about his relationship, Gekiha finds himself in Dandivine's cockpit with the Aposdolls' return.

videos.title: Outcome of a Confession
videos.overview: Gekiha is officially Dandivine's new pilot, but will his new duties allow him to attend to his love life?

videos.title: The Golden Transfer Student
videos.overview: A new transfer student named Suruga arrives at Gekiha's school and makes a huge impact.

videos.title: With Friends Like These...
videos.overview: Gekiha and Suruga each ponder the identity of their rival robot's pilot, blind to the truth.

videos.title: Ballad of the Slippers
videos.overview: Gekiha is injured and bedridden, leaving Dandivine without a pilot.

videos.title: What Defines a Protagonist
videos.overview: Gekiha has lost both Akane and Dandivine to Suruga. But will he give them up without a fight?
